items.name: Mikkenaxen
items.description: This item is of the finest craftsmanship and bears runework of the Ulfen culture. It's name "Mikkenaxe" is written above the blade on the left side. Runes of werewolf bane are written on the right.

items.name: Potion of Endure Elements
items.description:
A creature protected by endure elements suffers no harm from being in a hot or cold environment. It can exist comfortably in conditions between -50 and 140 degrees Fahrenheit without having to make Fortitude saves. The creature's equipment is likewise protected.
Endure elements doesn't provide any protection from fire or cold damage, nor does it protect against other environmental hazards such as smoke, lack of air, and so forth.

items.name: Vorkstag's Getaway Go-Juice
items.description:
This potion uses a combination of Monkey Fish, Spider Climb, and Burrow effects to create the ultimate movement potion buff for 10 minutes.

For the duration, the imbiber has 2 extra hooved feet, two extra clawed arms that protrude from their mid-section, and two tentacles covered in suction cups. These limbs can only be used for movement.

items.name: Vorkstag's Tonbokiri Draft
items.description: Imbiber receives Bull's Strength and Bear's Endurance effects, but must make a will-save to cease combat. If the save fails, they keep melee-attacking whatever target is nearest.

items.name: Captain's Coat
items.description: Functionally a masterwork chain shirt, this coat bears the epaulets of a sea-captain and should only be worn by one of such rank.

items.name: Kit, Disguise
items.description:
Price 50 gp; Weight 8 lbs.

This kit contains tools like makeup and fake facial hair, and provides a +2 circumstance bonus on Disguise checks. A disguise kit is exhausted after 10 uses.
